versions.changelog:
Redesign Skill v1.0.0 — First release

- Introduces an expert auditing and redesign process for upgrading websites and apps without breaking existing functionality.
- Provides a detailed design audit covering typography, color, layout, interactivity, and content patterns commonly found in generic "AI" interfaces.
- Recommends targeted improvements: higher-quality fonts, color refinement, innovative layout patterns, better states and feedback, and realistic content.
- Works flexibly with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.
- Focuses on elevating project polish and originality beyond cookie-cutter design solutions.
